1004878.etyen:
Partial calque of English British Somaliland, from britisk (“British”) + Somaliland. The name refers to the former British protectorate in the territory of present-day Somaliland.
Britisk (“British”) is derived from brite (“Briton”) + -isk (“-ish”). Det Norske Akademis ordbok derives brite from German Brite (“Briton”), while also comparing Old Norse Bretar (plural), English Briton, Old English Bret and Latin Brittō (“Briton”), ultimately from an Old Celtic form *Britt-os of uncertain origin. The suffix -isk (“-ish”) continues Old Norse -iskr, from Proto-Germanic *-iskaz, from Proto-Indo-Europe
